SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Section 1, Special Br. Staff.
REPORT
Date December 6, 19 37

Subject Communication from the Netherlands Consulate General
regarding Mrs. A. Jelowicka.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by C Crawford A.D.

Mrs. Anna Jelowicka, Polish citizen, was born in
1880 at Zytomiez, Poland. She is a divorcee. In 1925
she arrived in Shanghai from the U.S.S.R. to join her
daughter who was at that time married to a wealthy American citizen
named F. W. Sutterle. Following the departure of
Mrs. Sutterle from Shanghai about six months ago she resided
at 372 Rue Bourgeat, Apartment 28, with another daughter
of hers, Mrs. Vanda K. Sak, Russian emigrant, a separated
wife of an ex-officer of the Russian Imperial Army who is
in Poland at present.

Mrs. A. Jelowicka is registered with the local
Polish Consulate-General. Nothing detrimental is known
by this office regarding this person.

Tcheremshansky.
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch)

档案编号
第一部分，特别处职员。
报告
日期 1937 年 12 月 6 日

事由 荷兰总领事馆关于 A. 耶洛维茨卡（A. Jelowicka）女士的来函。

由 D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）拟稿 经 C. 克劳福德（Crawford）助理总监转呈

安娜·耶洛维茨卡（Anna Jelowicka）女士，波兰公民，1880 年生于波兰日托米尔（Zytomiez）。她系离异人士。1925 年，她从苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟抵达上海，投奔其当时嫁给一位名为 F. W. 萨特利（F. W. Sutterle）的富裕美国公民的女儿。大约在六个月前萨特利夫人离开上海后，她便与其另一女儿万达·K. 萨克（Vanda K. Sak）夫人同住于布尔热亚路（Rue Bourgeat）372 号 28 室。萨克夫人系俄国侨民，是现任居波兰的前俄罗斯帝国军队军官之分居妻子。

A. 耶洛维茨卡女士已在当地波兰总领事馆登记。本处所知关于此人之情况，并无任何不利之处。

切列姆尚斯基。
D. S.

副总监（特别处）

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No. 3937.

SHANGHAI, 26 November, 1937.

REGISTRY
No. S. L. D.

Sir,

I have the honor to inform you that Mrs. Anna ZELWINSKA
has applied to this Consulate General for a visa for admission
into the Netherlands Indies.

She is in possession of a Polish passport, issued by the
Polish Consulate at Shanghai on August 9, 1934 and extended till
August 9, 1939. According to her passport she is born at
Lodz, Poland, in 1896.

She states that one of her daughters Mrs. Sofie
Butterfield who will arrive at Shanghai on board of the
S.S. "Tientsin" has made a cable requesting her to return
to Lodz, as her husband is ill. Her daughter, a widow,
is in possession of a Dutch passport.

As the Polish Consulate informed me that Mrs. Zelwinska
has formerly known a visa for the Netherlands Indies was
granted. I should like to ask you to inform me, if possible,
whether anything is known against this person from a political
or moral point of view.

I have the honor to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔签名〕
Acting Consul-General.

S1
（印：B 1937 SHANGHAI）

W. S. O. Schokking
C. 99/11

The Deputy Commissioner,
Special & Crime Branches,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

D.D.R 29/11

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。
第 3937 号。

上海，1937 年 11 月 26 日。

登记处
编号 S. L. D.

先生：

谨此通知阁下，安娜·泽尔温斯卡（Anna ZELWINSKA）女士已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证。

她持有一本波兰护照，该护照由波兰驻上海领事馆于 1934 年 8 月 9 日签发，有效期延至 1939 年 8 月 9 日。根据其护照记载，她于 1896 年生于波兰罗兹（Lodz）。

她称，其女索菲·巴特菲尔德（Sofie Butterfield）夫人将乘“天津”号轮船（S.S. "Tientsin"）抵达上海，并已发电报请求她返回罗兹，因其丈夫患病。她的女儿是一位寡妇，持有荷兰护照。

鉴于波兰领事馆告知我，泽尔温斯卡女士此前曾获发荷属东印度签证。故恳请阁下尽可能告知，从政治或道德角度而言，是否有关于对此人不利的记录。

谨致
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

〔签名〕
代总领事。

S1
（印：B 1937 上海）

W. S. O. 肖金（Schokking）
C. 99/11

副总监，
特别处及刑事处，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

D.D.R 11 月 29 日
